properties.description: The 48 explicit root groups generate the full intrinsic Albert stabilizer
Uniform perfectness from same-length A2 commutators, including q=2
The full group has trivial center, without taking a projective quotient
The actual trace-zero rank-one point action is primitive over every field
Field isomorphisms preserve all 48 root groups with their parameters
Coefficientwise field transport intertwines the actual projective point actions
Canonical local radicals transform by actual conjugation
Each local radical is normal in its actual point stabilizer
Every local radical has order q^15
Complete package retaining the full Albert model and geometric interfaces
Genuine finite-field realization for every prime p and exponent f>=1
Nonabelian simple existence witnessed by the actual Albert model
Uniform existence and exact order for all prime powers

catalogue_scope.construction: Full stabilizer of the integral cubic polynomial and distinguished unit in the marked 27-dimensional split Albert space
catalogue_scope.parameters: F is an arbitrary finite field, q=|F|; every prime power q>=2, including characteristics 2 and 3
